question: The WTT Solution article from March 2025 indicates that Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software is trending in the healthcare industry. How can MediConn Solutions leverage this software to drive the growth of its healthcare services, using patient benefits from the software as a key to increased business by the year 2028?

insights.question: How much growth did MediConn Solutions experience after implementing a CRM system for virtual healthcare, and what are the projections for future growth based on this trend?
insights.answer: Between the launch of its CRM system in January 2023 and the end of January 2025, MediConn Solutions' virtual healthcare business grew by 10%, according to the company's annual report. If this growth trend continues, MediConn solutions could be 31.1% larger by 2028.

insights.question: Is there a CRM system feature that MediConn patients highlight as a reason for switching from a previous provider to MediConn Solutions?
insights.answer: Yes, in a survey conducted by MediConn's Quality Assurance Team in September 2025, patients ranked automated reminders as the number 1 reason, out of 10, that they switched healthcare providers. Healthcare CRM software can smooth communication between patients and their providers through the use of automatic reminders for appointments and medication. This ensures that patients stay engaged in their care plans without extra work on their part.

insights.question: How has using CRM software made MediConn's services even more cost-effective for patients over the past year, and how much savings potential does this represent forward into the next year?
insights.answer: According to an internal financial review conducted from September 2024 to September 2025, MediConn has been able to save 20% on labor costs by automating repetitive processes through its CRM, a savings which has been passed directly on to its clients through lower annual fees. This savings is projected to increase to 23% over the next year.

insights.question: Besides automated reminders and cost effectiveness, what other features available on MediConn Solutions' new CRM software would be important to customers?
insights.answer: According to a survey of virtual healthcare patients completed in January 2025, 90% of patients ranked personalized and timely care as two of the top five reasons for choosing a healthcare provider.
